basic_profile.bio: An avid tech enthusiast and part-time gamer based in Seattle, Washington. With a background in computer science, I work as a software developer during the day and enjoy unwinding with video games and anime in the evenings. A big fan of Mario Kart and basketball, I also dabble in model building and DIY projects. I'm happily married and enjoy spending weekends exploring the Pacific Northwest. Typically active on Reddit in the evenings and late at night, especially during gaming sessions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Holds a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science from the University of Washington. Over 10 years of experience in software development, specializing in front-end technologies. A self-taught enthusiast in gaming, anime, and model building, often learning through online resources and community forums.
